minutes.headline: Committee heard hours of comment against FY25 cuts; no budget vote taken, athletics and BCBA cuts stay on the table.
minutes.summary: The School Committee met in the Middle High School auditorium and heard extensive public comment opposing proposed staff cuts, especially athletics, music, special education paras and the BCBA. The superintendent presented alternative cuts that would restore the athletic director, trainer and a BCBA. Members said they were not ready to decide individual positions. School choice and committee reports were tabled.

what_happened.line: The School Committee took no vote on the FY25 budget cuts, and the athletic director, trainer and BCBA positions stay on the table.
Public comment ran for much of the meeting against cuts to athletics, music, special education paras and the BCBA, with a second round later.
The superintendent presented alternative cuts that would restore the athletic director, trainer and a BCBA; members said they were not ready to decide individual positions.
The committee tabled the school choice discussion 5-0, and the calendar vote was pushed to Feb 7.
The finance director position will not be reposted for now, with consultants used until March.

why_it_matters: Which school staff positions survive in the FY25 budget is still undecided, so athletics, music and special education services residents spoke for are not yet settled either way.
Several speakers raised an override and fees as ways to close the shortfall; any override would be a vote residents are asked to take, and no such vote has been scheduled in these minutes.
watch_next: The Feb 7 school calendar vote, and the school choice item carried to the next meeting.
A committee decision on the athletic director, trainer and BCBA positions, which was tabled.

reconciliation.summary: The records agree on the Box Tops donation, several reimbursement and fee figures, and some board members, while captions garble the warrant total and most names. The main difference is that our minutes record two 5-0 votes to table (school choice and committee reports) and two related decisions that the official minutes do not record, and the two records differ on the finance director outcome.
